<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $onePointZero,
        public ?string $sciHundred,
        public ?string $tenth,
        public ?string $tiny,
        public ?string $small,
        public ?string $edgeLow,
        public ?string $big,
        public ?string $huge,
        public ?string $e21,
        public ?string $e20,
        public ?string $negZero,
        public ?string $negZeroF,
        public ?string $neg,
        public ?string $minDouble,
        public ?string $maxDouble,
        public ?string $overflow,
        public ?string $capE,
        public ?string $third,
        public ?string $list,
        public ?int $plain,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            onePointZero: $data['onePointZero'],
            sciHundred: $data['sciHundred'],
            tenth: $data['tenth'],
            tiny: $data['tiny'],
            small: $data['small'],
            edgeLow: $data['edgeLow'],
            big: $data['big'],
            huge: $data['huge'],
            e21: $data['e21'],
            e20: $data['e20'],
            negZero: $data['negZero'],
            negZeroF: $data['negZeroF'],
            neg: $data['neg'],
            minDouble: $data['minDouble'],
            maxDouble: $data['maxDouble'],
            overflow: $data['overflow'],
            capE: $data['capE'],
            third: $data['third'],
            list: $data['list'],
            plain: $data['plain'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'onePointZero' => $this->onePointZero,
            'sciHundred' => $this->sciHundred,
            'tenth' => $this->tenth,
            'tiny' => $this->tiny,
            'small' => $this->small,
            'edgeLow' => $this->edgeLow,
            'big' => $this->big,
            'huge' => $this->huge,
            'e21' => $this->e21,
            'e20' => $this->e20,
            'negZero' => $this->negZero,
            'negZeroF' => $this->negZeroF,
            'neg' => $this->neg,
            'minDouble' => $this->minDouble,
            'maxDouble' => $this->maxDouble,
            'overflow' => $this->overflow,
            'capE' => $this->capE,
            'third' => $this->third,
            'list' => $this->list,
            'plain' => $this->plain,
        ];
    }
}
